entities.summary: George Martin Dixon was an American rugby union player who competed in the 1924 Summer Olympics. Dixon was born in Vallejo, California. He played rugby for the Olympic Club RFC in San Francisco, and was a member of the American rugby union team which won the Olympic gold medal in Paris.
